entities.name: Pietro Tomasi della Torretta, 12th Prince of Lampedusa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pietro Paolo Tomasi, known as Pietro Tomasi della Torretta after his title marchese della Torretta, was an Italian politician and diplomat. He ultimately inherited the family title of Prince of Lampedusa from his nephew, Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa, and was its last holder either officially or by inheritance. From 1922 to 1927, he served as the Ambassador of Italy to the United Kingdom and from 20 July 1944 until his resignation on 25 June 1946, he served as President of the Senate.
